maya: Quick micro open-mic — drop your best two-word life motto. winner gets one cookie :cookie:
aj: ship fast
sasha: be kind
diego: hydrate more :droplet:
lina: debug later
maya: love it. keep them coming! :grin:
aj: vote for 'hydrate more' if you're a plant parent :seedling:
sasha: vote 'be kind' — unanimous emoji strategy :thumbsup:
diego: adding a wildcard: 'nap algorithms' :zzz:
lina: how about a haiku instead? three lines fast:
    lina: "two-word motto"
    lina: "makes my coffee braver"
    lina: "I still hit snooze"
maya: 😂 that turned into a tiny poem. official poll via reactions?
ops-bot: Reminder: office cookie jar is first-come-first-serve. Please label personal stashes with your name. :robot_face:
aj: noted ops-bot. also: 'ship fast' is my dark-horse pick.
sasha: results so far — :thumbsup: for 'be kind', :heart: for 'hydrate more', :fire: for 'ship fast'
maya: closing in 5 — winner announced. runner-up gets bragging rights.
last_recap_bot: Winner: 'be kind' — congrats sasha, claim your imaginary cookie :cookie: 
aj: congrats! quick one-liner victory dance? :tada:
